calibration.assessmentStateNote: Superseded scaffold (bae71c705, F4B-10's digest-ripple wave): the prior normalizedStops bundled BOTH channels into one `value` object per stop (`{intensity, durationScale}`), a shape `ingressValueForStop`'s `bounded` branch cannot lower -- it requires `stop.value` to be a finite NUMBER, one channel at a time, selected by `stop.role` against the ingress SET (`runtime/ingress/index.mjs:811-816`). Replaced with 4 single-channel stops (2 per role) plus one identity stop, matching the SAME role-selection mechanism `palette.seeds` already uses for its own multi-member ingress set. Not a re-touch of a closed control: this control was never past UNKNOWN/scaffold before this packet.

normalizedStops.law: STATIC ARM ONLY (F4B-8/W-A/W-B law: an identity stop is a claim about what the VERTICAL ships, and the DB arm takes no baseline by law, H-1 V5, so it cannot resolve one). NOT RECEIPTED, matching palette.seeds' own precedent (its `primary/identity` stop carries zero staticDbParityEvidenceIds too): a single-arm causal run structurally cannot produce a passing receipt under this evidence kind (`ingressEquivalenceHeld` requires 2 comparable arms, `composition/run/index.mjs:516`, so a static-arm-only run's own `verdict.pass` is always false and the CLI refuses to write a receipt for it -- confirmed by attempting one this packet, F4B-13). Identity is therefore stated here as a directly-compiled fact (`compileTheme` via `dist/server.js`, re-verified this packet post-rebuild), not as receipted evidence. All 3 verticals author intensity, by three different mechanisms: rottay authors `intensity: 1.0` inline (const MOTION, rottay/index.ts:3761-3762) -- coincides in VALUE with the DS seed but is STRUCTURALLY authored, same class as F4B-8's other coincidental identities. bithire authors `intensity: 0.55` inline (const MOTION, bithire/index.ts:4058-4061) -- a genuine non-default identity value, unclamped. evnto authors `intensity: 1.5` through a frozen, evnto-owned preset constant (`EVNTO_CANONICAL_MOTION`, foundation/presets/policy/experience-baselines/evnto/index.ts:36), NOT by absence -- an earlier draft of this note wrongly claimed evnto has no motion authorship at all; corrected this packet after a second, wider grep surfaced the indirection (`motion: EVNTO_CANONICAL_MOTION`, evnto/index.ts:4922). 1.5 is OUTSIDE MOTION_DIAL_BOUNDS.intensity's own ceiling (0..1) -- the compiler's static-arm clamp (kernel/foundation/css/appearance-posture/index.ts:173-176) contains it to `--ds-motion-intensity: 1` at compile time (directly measured: `compileTheme(FIRST_PARTY_THEMES.evnto, {vertical:'evnto', mode:'light'}).cssVariables['--ds-motion-intensity'] === '1'`), which coincides with the DS seed at the OUTPUT only -- the INPUT is a genuine, structurally-authored, out-of-envelope identity that the dial's own bounds mechanism visibly contains, arguably the most informative of the three.

calibration.identityNote: durationScale has NO identity in any of the 3 verticals: none authors it literally (grep-confirmed), and it carries no DS-seed default either -- all 3 baselines compile `--ds-motion-duration-scale` to `undefined`. `ambient` is documented, not a stop: it emits no CSS custom property (`intentionally emits no CSS custom property`, the type's own comment), so it is behaviour, not a channel, and stays outside causal verification by design -- the 2 declared channels (`--ds-motion-intensity`, `--ds-motion-duration-scale`) cover `intensity`/`durationScale` fully.
calibration.negativeControlsScopeNote: `motion remains fixed` is deliberately NOT declared -- this control's entire job is moving animation-duration/transition channels, so that negative control would assert against the very properties the dial legitimately moves. The other four are declared in full: motion.dial shares no channel with colour, geometry (radius/border) or typography, so nothing narrows them the way surfaces.elevation-posture narrows `border remains fixed` to its width/style-only variant. `control height remains fixed` bound to card-modern-md/root (same precedent target as surfaces.elevation-posture/navigation.sidebar-tone).
calibration.nextAction: RERUN_CAUSAL_PROOF_AFTER_TREE_FREEZE. Previous receipts remain append-only historical evidence but no longer support an active claim after the canonical-path refactor.
calibration.dialBoundsLaw: GLOBAL rangeBounds (the widest ceiling ANY vertical envelope could declare), copied literally from MOTION_DIAL_BOUNDS (contracts/runtime/motion/index.ts:10-13, re-verified this packet, byte-identical). Distinct from `domain.bounds` above (0..0.8), which is the NARROWER per-vertical envelope actually enforced today (TENANT_THEME_VERTICAL_ENVELOPES, identical across all 3 first-party verticals) -- `domain.bounds` states the real, currently-enforced gate; this field states the widest a vertical COULD widen it to under the schema's own ceiling. Both are contract bounds, read by reference, never redeclared by the tenant document schema (kernel/foundation/schemas/tenant-theme/index.ts:187-189). The narrower tenant floor `normalizedStops` respects is the per-vertical envelope (0..0.8/0.75..1.35), not this wider global ceiling -- the 4 stops above are chosen inside the narrower range so every stop compiles on every vertical without tripping the hard gate.
